initial.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Back the resident Shepherd with a configured model
initial.goal: Give every Polis a required resident Shepherd whose reasoning is backed by a declaratively configured provider and model without making transient inference failure fatal to the Runtime.
initial.required_outcome: Runtime configuration selects a non-empty set of uniquely named resident Shepherds and each provider profile, model, endpoint reference, and preload policy; startup preloads models before Shepherd readiness; Shepherd reasoning uses the governed provider path; truthful health and lifetime recovery with bounded probes isolate temporary model failures from the rest of the Runtime.
authority_boundary: The execution base must contain merged #617 canonical-name projection
Runtime configuration is authoritative for the resident Shepherd provider, model, endpoint reference, preload policy, and canonical identity
Provider credentials remain external and must never appear in roster, detail, logs, or evidence
Existing governed-operation and agent-continuity boundaries remain authoritative
operator_constraints: Never write tracked issue work on main
Do not hard-code Ollama or qwen3:8b
Do not use short fixed launch or inference deadlines
Temporary provider failure must not terminate the Runtime or unrelated agents
Require at least one resident Shepherd, reject duplicate canonical identities, and use typed C-SDLC v2 authority
initial.task_boundary: One provider-backed resident Shepherd configuration, preload, execution, health, recovery, API, and focused proof slice; no general dynamic-agent lifecycle redesign.
deliverables: Provider-backed Shepherd executor through the governed operation boundary
Startup preload and idempotent non-fatal recovery behavior
Truthful readiness, blocking-reason, roster/detail, and Observatory provider/model health projection without credentials
Focused configuration, provider, preload, restart, isolation, and API tests
Bounded Wuji restart and governed-inference acceptance evidence
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Runtime configuration requires a non-empty resident Shepherd set, validates each canonical identity/provider/model/endpoint/preload policy, and rejects duplicate canonical identities
AC-2: The Shepherd invokes its declared provider/model through the existing governed operation boundary
AC-3: The Shepherd remains model_loading until provider health and preload succeed, then reports ready

AC-4: Provider/model identity and admitted, model_loading, ready, or degraded health are observable without credentials; /v1/ready, blocking_reasons, roster/detail, and Observatory snapshot/feed agree
AC-5: Temporary provider or model failure visibly degrades and retries the Shepherd without terminating the Runtime or unrelated agents
AC-6: Restart reconstructs one resident per unique configured Shepherd identity, rejects duplicates, and repeats preload without manual provider commands
AC-7: Existing checkpoint, continuity, canonical-name, and non-Shepherd lifecycle behavior remains valid
AC-8: Wuji acceptance with a local Ollama model proves restart, automatic preload, truthful health, and one successful governed Shepherd inference
dependencies: Issue #617 and PR #636 must be merged into the execution base
non_goals: Making temporary inference degradation terminate the Runtime
General dynamic-agent lifecycle, migration, or checkpoint redesign
Reimplementing #617 canonical-name work or stacking its unmerged PR into #640
Broad workspace test execution when focused Runtime proof is sufficient
initial.plan_summary: Add provider-neutral resident Shepherd configuration, replace its native placeholder reasoning path with the governed provider executor, implement preload and isolated recovery state, expose truthful health, and prove it with focused tests plus bounded Wuji acceptance.

steps.action: Extend and validate resident Shepherd configuration and thread authoritative identity/provider/model/preload values into Runtime bootstrap.
Wire Shepherd reasoning through the configured provider and existing governed operation boundary.
Implement startup preload, truthful readiness states, and idempotent non-fatal recovery with generous configurable budgets.
Derive /v1/ready, blocking_reasons, roster/detail, and Observatory snapshot/feed from one non-secret Shepherd health snapshot and update OpenAPI.
Run focused deterministic validation and bounded Wuji restart/preload/inference acceptance, then resolve independent exact-head review.

invariants: At least one resident Shepherd exists and each configured canonical identity is unique
Runtime configuration is the authority for Shepherd identity and provider selection
No provider credential is serialized or logged
Transient inference failure is isolated from Runtime and non-Shepherd availability
No short timeout becomes a Runtime termination condition
Canonical name and lifecycle continuity delivered by #617 remain unchanged
risks: Provider-specific preload behavior leaks into the Runtime contract
A cold model exceeds a small startup or inference budget and creates false failure
Recovery creates duplicate Shepherds or provider tasks
API health claims ready before the model can actually infer
Provider failure incorrectly blocks whole-Runtime readiness or makes /v1/ready disagree with Observatory
Execution accidentally stacks or duplicates unmerged #617 changes
stop_conditions: Execution base does not contain merged #617/#636 state
Provider credentials would need to enter tracked config or API output
The design requires terminating the Runtime on temporary provider/model failure
A validation lane selects zero tests
Scope expands into general dynamic-agent lifecycle redesign
Wuji acceptance would overwrite another session's live configuration without coordination

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove required provider-neutral non-empty unique configuration, authoritative identity, and restart reconstruction with nonzero focused tests.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: The named resident_shepherd cases are issue #640 implementation deliverables.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove governed provider execution, preload state transitions, degraded isolation, generous timeout behavior, and idempotent recovery with nonzero focused tests.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: The named shepherd_provider cases are issue #640 implementation deliverables.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove truthful canonical identity plus agreement among /v1/ready, blocking_reasons, roster/detail, Observatory snapshot/feed, and OpenAPI with nonzero focused tests.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: The named shepherd_model_health and shepherd_readiness_consistency cases are issue #640 implementation deliverables.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove the exact candidate restarts on Wuji, automatically preloads its configured local model, reports ready, and completes one governed Shepherd inference without manual Ollama loading.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Live Wuji acceptance runs only after the exact candidate passes deterministic local proof and the host is coordinated.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove formatting for the Runtime kernel workspace.
Prove exact branch diff whitespace hygiene.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on missing #617 ancestry, invalid or secret-bearing configuration, an empty Shepherd set, duplicate configured identity, ungoverned inference, false or inconsistent readiness, whole-Runtime failure coupling, zero-test validation, stale review, or uncoordinated Wuji mutation.
review_prompts: Does configuration remain provider-neutral and keep credentials outside tracked and API surfaces?
Does the Shepherd execute through the existing governed operation boundary rather than a parallel inference path?
Can any preload or inference timeout terminate the Runtime or unrelated agents?
Do loading, ready, and degraded states reflect an actual provider/model probe?
Is recovery lifetime-long with bounded probes and intervals, and idempotent per configured canonical identity?
Does the branch start from merged #617 rather than carrying an accidental PR stack?
initial.review_scope: Exact #640 resident Shepherd configuration, provider execution, preload/recovery, health API, focused proof, and bounded Wuji acceptance only.
